exposure: gestational diabetes with poor glycemic control
Gestational diabetes with poor glycemic control
cohort: 207 infants born between 34 0/7 weeks and 36 6/7 weeks of gestation, with 59 developing hypoglycemia
finding: Postnatal environmental factors, such as skin-to-skin contact, breastfeeding, soft lightening, and normothermia, appear to be directly related to early hypoglycemia development.
mod_finding: Planned cesarean delivery is associated with a higher probability of hypoglycemia.
